description: Send the parent of a model ALREADY on Amazon its title and selling points again — a REAL change on a live listing: the model's Amazon title and points (set_channel_texts with modelId), else its name in the marketplace's language. Replaces only item_name and bullet_point; nothing else a person set in Seller Central changes. Run check_amazon_variation_parent first. Refused until the owner switches on AI publishing, and while sending content to Amazon (contentPush) is not armed on the Amazon connection. Returns the same report with status sent, nothing or rejected. Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

modelId.description: A product model id (the model a product's modelId points at; get_product shows it).

name: update_amazon_variation_parent
title: Update a model's parent on Amazon
